name: Question 14
problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 1 & \frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4} & 0 & 2 & 6 \\ 3 & \frac{1}{2} & 6 & \frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y+z=\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4}x-0y+2z=6 \\ 3x+\frac{1}{2}y+6z=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain 

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y+z=\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4}x+2z=6 \\ 3x+\frac{1}{2}y+6z=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[4111214026312613]

a
{4x+y+z=1214x+z=−63x+12y+6z=13
b
{4x+y+z=1214x+2z=63x−12y+6z=13
c
{4x+y+z=1214x−2z=63x+12y+6z=13
d
{4x+y+z=1214x+2z=63x+12y+6z=13
e
{4x−y+z=1214x+2z=63x+12y+6z=13
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x, y, and z, then, the corresponding system of equations is

{4x+y+z=1214x−0y+2z=63x+12y+6z=13.

By simplifying, we obtain

{4x+y+z=1214x+2z=63x+12y+6z=13.
